about: Local-model modules for Kz-harness. Git keeps only this manifest; the files go to engine/llama and models/ (both gitignored). Nothing installs by default: /install-llm in the chat, Settings -> Jev setup -> Local models, or Install-Harness.ps1 -LocalModels <ids|all>. Every file comes from `source` and must match `size` and `sha256` (GitHub release digest / Hugging Face LFS oid). Curated by hand: never add a model from an uploader other than the model's own organization. Fields: README.md, 'Local models & offline'.

modules.name: llama.cpp b10964 (release 0.4.1), Windows CUDA 12.4 x64
modules.notes: For NVIDIA GPUs whose driver supports CUDA 12.4 or newer (nvidia-smi 'CUDA Version'). Installed together with the CUDA 12.4 runtime below.

modules.name: CUDA 12.4 runtime DLLs for llama.cpp
modules.notes: cudart, cublas and cublasLt, unzipped next to llama-server.exe.

modules.name: llama.cpp b10964 (release 0.4.1), Windows CUDA 13.3 x64
modules.notes: For NVIDIA drivers that support CUDA 13.3 or newer. Installed together with the CUDA 13.3 runtime below.

modules.name: CUDA 13.3 runtime DLLs for llama.cpp

modules.name: llama.cpp b10964 (release 0.4.1), Windows Vulkan x64

modules.name: Qwen3 8B
modules.verifiedOn: RTX 3050 Laptop 4 GB + 24 GB RAM, 2026-09-20: 18/37 layers on GPU, ~8 tokens/s, tool calls OK
modules.notes: Q4_K_M. Needs ~5.7 GB of GPU memory to run fully on the GPU; with less it splits between GPU and CPU. Best local tool calling here. Qwen3.5-9B has no official GGUF yet.

agent.description: Qwen3 8B on this PC (llama.cpp): free, private, works offline, but much weaker and slower than the cloud agents. Good for simple edits, explanations and summaries; not for hard multi-file work.

modules.name: Gemma 4 E4B
modules.verifiedOn: RTX 3050 Laptop 4 GB + 24 GB RAM, 2026-09-20: 43/43 layers on GPU, ~47 tokens/s, tool calls OK
modules.notes: Google's QAT Q4_0 (no official Q4_K_M). 4.5B effective parameters; the file is large because of per-layer embeddings, which stay in RAM. Needs ~3 GB of GPU memory to run fully on the GPU.

agent.description: Gemma 4 E4B on this PC (llama.cpp): free, private, works offline, fast but the weakest agent. Good for short explanations, summaries and tiny edits; not for multi-file or tricky work.

modules.name: Gemma 4 E4B vision add-on
modules.notes: Optional: lets Gemma 4 E4B read images (passed to llama-server as --mmproj; runs on the CPU so the GPU keeps the text model). Not tested on this PC yet.
